title: ForecastingSourceDefinition - Tooling API
description: Represents the object, measure, date type, and hierarchy that a forecast uses to project sales. This object is available in API version 52.0 and later.

CategoryField.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
CategoryField.description: Name of the forecast category that is associated with the forecast type. Possible values are: Opportunity.ForecastCategoryName

DateField.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
DateField.description: Field that is used for the forecast type’s date type. For example, the CloseDate field on Opportunity is used for opportunity close date–based forecast types. Possible values are: Opportunity.CloseDate OpportunityLineItem.ServiceDate

DeveloperName.description: The name of the forecasting source definition.

FamilyField.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
FamilyField.description: Use this field to group forecasts by product family. Possible values are: Product2.Family

FullName.description: The full name of the forecasting source definition.

Language.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Language.description: The language of the forecasting source definition.

MasterLabel.description: Controlling label for this forecasting source definition.

MeasureField.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
MeasureField.description: Field that is used for the forecast type’s measure. For example, the Amount field on Opportunity is associated with revenue-based forecast types. Possible values are*: Opportunity.Amount Opportunity.Custom Opportunity.TotalOpportunityQuantity OpportunityLineItem.Custom OpportunityLineItem.Quantity OpportunityLineItem.TotalPrice *Where Custom represents the name of the custom field that a forecast type’s measure is based on. Example: Use the Megawatts__c custom field to forecast energy consumption.

Metadata.description: The metadata of the forecasting source definition.

SourceObject.description: Object associated with this forecasting source definition. Possible values are: Opportunity OpportunityLineItem Product2

Territory2Field.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
Territory2Field.description: For a territory-based forecast type, indicates the field that is used for territory information.For user role–based forecast types, this value is null.

UserField.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
UserField.description: Specifies who owns the forecast. Possible values are: Opportunity.OwnerId

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<xsd:complexType name="ForecastingSourceDefinition">
  <xsd:complexContent>
    <xsd:extension base="mns:Metadata">
      <xsd:sequence>
        <xsd:element name="categoryField" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="cdpDataspace" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="dateField" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="externalSourceObject" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="familyField" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="isProtected" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <xsd:element name="masterLabel" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="measureField" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="sourceObject" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="territory2Field" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="userField" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
      </xsd:sequence>
    </xsd:extension>
  </xsd:complexContent>
</xsd:complexType>
```
